verdict.rationale: GitHub's own materials say it can "detect, prevent, and remediate leaked secrets across your organization" (github-docs-7). They also describe push protection confirming an active secret and blocking the push (github-docs-15), which covers both the detection and the org-wide scope of the story. The evidence is limited to marketing-level claims with no in-depth documentation of the remediation workflow. missing for 10: detailed docs on org-wide secret scanning alerts and remediation/revocation workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
